title: Simple Daily Habits to Stop Drain Clogs Before They Start
description: Preventing blocked drains is much easier than clearing a backed-up pipe. The most common causes of indoor drain blockages are cooking grease, food scraps, soap scum, and hair. In the kitchen, always use a fine-mesh drain strainer to catch solid waste before it reaches your P-trap. Never pour fats, oils, or grease down the sink; let them cool in a container and dispose of them in the trash. In bathrooms, hair catchers over shower and basin drains protect your plumbing from stubborn mats. A few simple habits keep your waste lines flowing freely and protect your home from costly plumbing emergencies.
